messages:
emma_support: FYI — customer trial-345 says ~120k credits disappeared overnight. They ran a nightly embed job at 02:00 and see repeated attempts.
matt_infra: ack. can you paste the job id + any logs? I'll grep infra logs for restarts.
emma_support: job_id=job_2026_03_17_02_00
emma_support: logs from customer agent:
```
2026-03-17T02:00:02Z INFO enqueue job job_2026_03_17_02_00
2026-03-17T02:00:03Z INFO worker started job_2026_03_17_02_00
2026-03-17T02:00:05Z ERROR embed-service 502 bad gateway
2026-03-17T02:00:05Z INFO worker retrying job_2026_03_17_02_00 retry_token=rt-abc123
2026-03-17T02:00:10Z INFO worker started job_2026_03_17_02_00
2026-03-17T02:00:12Z INFO embed-service 502 bad gateway
2026-03-17T02:00:12Z INFO worker requeue job_2026_03_17_02_00 retry_token=rt-abc123
2026-03-17T02:00:20Z INFO enqueue job job_2026_03_17_02_00 (duplicate)
```
emma_support: customer says they saw ~15 identical attempts.
sasha_engineer: interesting — two things to check: (1) scheduler leader election may have enqueued duplicate cron jobs after a pod restart, (2) worker retry logic currently retries on any 5xx and re-enqueues without deduping by retry_token + job_id.
olivia_prodops: we had a rolling restart of the schedule-controller at 01:59 due to a config rollout (k8s), leader switched at 02:00:07. that aligns with the duplicate enqueue.
matt_infra: confirmed in controller logs: "leader lost, starting leader election" then a resume that enqueued pending cron triggers. will paste snippet.
```
2026-03-17T01:59:58Z INFO controller rolling update: restarting pod/schedule-controller-2
2026-03-17T02:00:07Z INFO controller leader elected: pod/schedule-controller-3
2026-03-17T02:00:07Z INFO controller reconcile: enqueuing missed cron jobs (count=12)
```
sasha_engineer: combine that with worker behavior: when embed endpoint returns 502 we do immediate requeue with same retry_token but no global dedupe, and the scheduler re-enqueue created additional independent jobs — result: fan-out.
emma_support: ok — so double source: scheduler duplicate enqueue + worker retries on 502. that explains multiplier.
matt_infra: proposed mitigations:
- quick patch: worker should dedupe by (job_id, retry_token) within 10m window
- short-term: suppress automatic re-enqueue on 502 for embed/rerank endpoints (make it only requeue on 429/timeout)
- scheduler: make leader handoff suppress re-enqueue of jobs that were executed <1m ago
sasha_engineer: I'll own the worker patch. small change, add memcache-backed seen keys and a metric. PR target: today, will test in staging.
olivia_prodops: I'll change controller to include a "recently_executed" guard and roll canary to prod at 10:30 PST. will monitor.
billing_bot: created case BLG-7892, provisional credit of 120000 applied to trial-345 pending final reconciliation.
emma_support: thx. I'll update the customer: explain overlap root cause, provisional credit applied, and ETA for fix. will ask if they want logs for audit.
matt_infra: follow-ups: add alert for sudden credits burn (>50k in 1h) and dashboard showing duplicate job envelopes per cron run.
sasha_engineer: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/worker/pull/412 (dedupe + metric). test vector included.
emma_support: customer replied: "thanks for fast response — appreciate the provisional credit, please let us know when fixed." :thumbsup:
olivia_prodops: will post rollout status in #eng-ops once canary looks good.
emma_support: closing loop here when billing confirms final reconciliation. assigning internal follow-up to BLG-7892."
